visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A metal bowl containing yellow custard is shown, with a metal whisk stirring the mixture. The background is a clean white kitchen countertop. (2) Hands whisk egg yolks and sugar in the bowl, creating a vibrant yellow mixture. (3) White flour is sifted into the bowl using a metal sieve and whisked into the mixture until smooth. (4) Milk is heated in a stainless steel pot on a black gas stove, with a digital thermometer checking the temperature. (5) The warm milk is poured into the egg mixture while whisking continuously. (6) The combined mixture is poured back into the pot and cooked on a low gas flame. (7) Continuous whisking thickens the custard until bubbles form on the surface. (8) Yellow butter is added to the warm custard and blended in. (9) Plastic wrap is pressed directly onto the surface of the finished custard in the bowl. (10) A piece of golden-brown bread is pulled apart to reveal the creamy custard filling.
